intervals.label: project (T-REX)
intervals.note: The page says first activities along this line already existed in the group before the grant; 2009 is the start of the ERC grant, not a founding date. The project is still described as active (papers up to 2025).
intervals.quote: this line of research was granted a Starting Grant of the European Research Council (ERC) during 2009-2015.

website.quote: Welcome to the homepage of the T-REX project in the Universidad de Zaragoza!!

name: T-REX project (TREX-DM)
notes: Not the same body as collaboration:anais (the same Zaragoza group runs ANAIS-112 at the same laboratory, as a separate experiment and collaboration). No roster or formation date was found.

summary.plain: The Universidad de Zaragoza group that develops time projection chambers for rare-event searches and built the TREX-DM dark matter detector installed at the Canfranc Underground Laboratory.
summary.technical: T-REX (TPCs for Rare Event eXperiments) is an R&D project of the Group of Nuclear and Astroparticle Physics (GIFNA; the recent papers give CAPA) of the Universidad de Zaragoza, supported by an ERC Starting Grant in 2009-2015. TREX-DM papers are authored by the Zaragoza group; the papers do not call it a 'collaboration'.
